title: An Efficient Vertex Retrieval Algorithm for Ball Polyhedra
summary: We consider the intersection $\mathcal{Q}$ of $m$ equal-radius balls in $\mathbb{R}^n$ whose centers lie on a common sphere centered at the origin, with the origin contained in the convex hull of the centers. Assuming $\mathcal{Q}$ possesses a unique vertex $x^{\star}$ lying on the hyperplane $1_{n \times 1}^T \cdot x=0$, under a combinatorial-stability assumption, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that recovers $x^\star$.
